ns2:course.label: Athletic Bands
ns2:course.description: Prepares and performs music of the highest available quality for men's and women's basketball and volleyball games. May be repeated to a maximum of 10 hours. Prerequisite: Auditions for the Athletic Bands take place during the first week of classes in the fall semester. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation.
